锁屏PIN
人脸识别
指纹认证
凭据管理

如何查询当前设备支持的用户认证能力（人脸、指纹、口令）？
如何发起人脸+指纹+锁屏口令的组合认证请求？

当你的应用需要验证用户身份才能执行敏感操作时使用本Kit，例如应用内账号登录、支付认证、敏感数据访问等场景
三方应用调用系统本地身份认证能力时，必须使用系统自带的身份认证控件
当你的应用需要根据不同安全等级要求选择合适的认证方式时，可以通过指定认证可信等级（ATL）来确保安全性与便捷性的平衡
当需要避免用户频繁重复认证时，可以使用认证结果复用功能
实现登录前的人脸或指纹验证 / Add face or fingerprint verification before sign-in
调用统一认证弹窗校验用户身份后再执行敏感操作 / Use the unified auth prompt to verify identity before a sensitive action
集成生物识别解锁应用内保险箱或私密页面 / Integrate biometric unlock for an in-app vault or private screen
在支付、转账或提现前触发设备凭据认证 / Require device credential authentication before payment, transfer, or withdrawal
用指纹加锁设置页并在进入时重新认证 / Protect the settings page with fingerprint and re-authenticate on entry
获取设备支持的认证方式并按能力动态显示人脸/指纹入口 / Get supported auth types and show face or fingerprint entry dynamically
复用系统最近一次解锁结果避免重复验证 / Reuse the recent system unlock result to avoid repeated verification
监听指纹或人脸凭据变更并刷新安全设置状态 / Listen for fingerprint or face credential changes and refresh security settings
检测生物认证被锁定或冻结并提示改用锁屏密码 / Detect biometric lockout or freeze and fall back to lock screen password
发起人脸加密码的多因素身份认证 / Start multi-factor authentication with face plus passcode
在认证流程中允许用户取消并安全回退页面 / Allow users to cancel authentication and safely return
从系统生物认证切换到自定义验证界面继续流程 / Switch from system biometric authentication to a custom verification UI
管理应用内高风险操作的二次身份校验 / Manage step-up identity verification for high-risk in-app actions
do_not_use_when: 需求是服务端账号登录、令牌校验、单点登录或联网身份验证，而不是设备本地生物/口令认证；请改用 online-authentication-kit / The need is server-side account login, token validation, SSO, or online identity verification rather than on-device biometric/passcode authentication; use online-authentication-kit instead

需求是生成、存储、导入、导出或使用密钥进行加解密/签名验签，而不是触发用户认证流程；请改用 universal-keystore-kit / The need is to generate, store, import, export, or use keys for encryption/decryption or signing/verification rather than trigger user authentication; use universal-keystore-kit instead

需求是设备证书申请、安装、查询或基于证书建立设备身份信任，而不是验证当前用户身份；请改用 device-certificate-kit / The need is device certificate enrollment, installation, query, or certificate-based device identity trust rather than verifying the current user; use device-certificate-kit instead

需求是检查设备安全状态、风险检测、系统完整性或安全配置，而不是执行一次用户认证；请改用 device-security-kit / The need is to inspect device security status, risk signals, system integrity, or security configuration rather than perform a user authentication; use device-security-kit instead

需求是DRM内容授权、许可证处理或受保护媒体播放控制，而不是通用敏感操作的人机身份校验；请改用 drm-kit / The need is DRM content authorization, license handling, or protected media playback control rather than human identity verification for a general sensitive action; use drm-kit instead
preconditions: 应用已集成并可访问 User Authentication Kit 对应SDK接口 / The app has integrated and can access the User Authentication Kit SDK APIs
设备已设置至少一种本地认证凭据（锁屏口令、人脸或指纹）且相关能力可用 / The device has at least one local authenticator enrolled (lock screen credential, face, or fingerprint) and the capability is available

应用界面处于前台并能够展示系统认证控件；三方应用不得绕过系统控件自行采集生物特征 / The app UI is in the foreground and can present the system authentication UI; third-party apps must not bypass the system control to collect biometrics themselves
inputs: 认证类型与组合策略 / authentication types and combination policy
认证可信等级要求（ATL） / required authentication trust level (ATL)
认证界面配置参数（标题、说明、按钮文案等） / authentication UI configuration parameters (title, description, button text, etc.)
是否允许复用近期认证结果及复用时间窗口 / whether recent authentication reuse is allowed and the reuse window
认证回调或结果处理对象 / authentication callback or result handler

postconditions.statement: 已调用用户认证相关API发起认证，或已接入系统提供的认证控件 / A user authentication API has been invoked to start authentication, or the system-provided authentication control has been integrated
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show code that imports or references the user authentication kit and starts an authentication request or renders/configures the system authentication control?

postconditions.statement: 认证流程包含结果处理逻辑，能够区分成功、失败、取消或错误状态 / The authentication flow includes result handling logic that distinguishes success, failure, cancellation, or error states
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there explicit handling for authentication outcomes such as success and at least one non-success path like failure, cancellation, or error?

postconditions.statement: 若配置了认证方式或ATL，代码中已显式传入相应约束而非完全依赖默认值 / If authentication factors or ATL were intended, the code explicitly passes those constraints instead of relying entirely on defaults
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the changes show explicit configuration of authentication type(s), combination policy, or ATL requirements when such security constraints are part of the requested behavior?
